verdict.rationale: LangSmith's docs say datasets can be built from historical production traces, and that real traces can be added to a dataset so an observed failure becomes a repeatable test. Its offline evaluation runs the application against those datasets as experiments, scored by human, code, LLM-as-judge, or pairwise evaluators, with configurable repetitions, concurrency, and caching, to compare versions and catch regressions. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the trace-to-dataset curation and offline-experiment workflow (all evidence is vendor docs).
